_doc: Golden JSON fixture for NodeStarted event in strict/ON mode (SAGE_STATECORE='1'). Pinned by tests/test_runtime_event_contracts.py.
_notes: ON-mode NodeStarted MUST carry predecessors_by_channel partition with the 3 canonical channel keys.
